notablePrerequisites: Your deck size is greater than or equal to an opponent's life total.
description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
All Will Be One triggers, dealing damage to target opponent equal to the counters placed this way.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
